description_en: Queries a list of model cards and returns the model name, provider, and source identifier for each card, along with the features, pricing, meta, availablePaths, and snapshots structures. The only business request parameter is the provider identifier
description_zh: 查询模型卡片（ModelCard）列表，返回每张卡片的模型名称、模型供应商与来源标识，并给出该卡片的 features、pricing、meta、availablePaths、snapshots 结构；唯一业务入参是模型供应商标识 provider
name: ListModelCards

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the model provider used to filter model cards by provider
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商标识，用于按模型供应商筛选模型卡片
parameters.name: provider

availablePaths.description_en: The list of available paths for the model card. Each element consists of a path and a type member. The API definition does not specify the criteria for determining availability
availablePaths.description_zh: 该模型卡片的 availablePaths 列表，每个元素由 path 与 type 两个成员组成；接口定义未说明“可用”的判定条件

path.description_en: The request path of the API

type.description_en: The type identifier of the available path record. The valid values are not specified in the API definition
type.description_zh: 该条 availablePaths 记录的类型标识；取值集合未在接口定义中声明

features.description_en: The feature configuration of the model card in a key-value pair map structure. The set of keys is not specified in the API definition
features.description_zh: 模型卡片的特性配置（features），映射（键值对）结构；接口定义未声明其键集合

meta.description_en: The metadata container of the model card. Only the description member is declared in the API definition
meta.description_zh: 模型卡片的元数据容器（meta）；接口定义在本篇只声明 description 一个成员

description.description_en: The description text of the model card
description.example: 该模型卡片的说明文本示例。

pricing.description_en: The pricing information of the model card in a key-value pair map structure. The set of keys and billing criteria are not specified in the API definition
pricing.description_zh: 模型卡片的定价信息（pricing），映射（键值对）结构；接口定义未声明其键集合与计费口径

provider.description_en: The identifier of the model provider for the model card
provider.description_zh: 该模型卡片对应的模型供应商标识

snapshots.description_en: The list of snapshots for the model card. Array items are map structures with unspecified members. The API definition does not specify the snapshot content or generation rules
snapshots.description_zh: 模型卡片的 snapshots 列表，数组项为未声明成员的映射结构；接口定义未说明快照内容与生成规则

source.description_en: The source identifier of the model card. The valid values are not specified in the API definition
source.description_zh: 模型卡片的来源标识；取值集合未在接口定义中声明
